about: Copy to .private-fixtures.json (git-ignored) to run tests on documents and tests kept OUTSIDE this repository (docs/DESIGN.md#testing). Paths are relative to the repository root; fixture paths are relative to 'root'. 'privateTests' (optional) is a folder of private tests laid out like test/ (engine/, unit/, integration/, converter/): scripts/private-tests.mjs compiles it into out/private/ and each test runner adds its tests. A fixture's kind is 'tex' or 'md'; an 'md' fixture may name an 'appendix' Markdown file, a preset 'mode' and an 'overrides' JSON file under 'root'. 'pairs' (optional) are reference pairs for a preset: a Markdown file and the .tex made from it, both read from a git repository at a commit, with an 'allow' list under 'root'. Without .private-fixtures.json all of these tests skip.
